goal: Add per-seat billing calculation for the team plan

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Team plan invoice uses the seat count

run_evidence.start_command: docker compose up -d && npm run dev

impact.compatibility: Existing individual plan path is unchanged; the team plan uses a new code path.
impact.risk_notes: Touches billing; requires 2 approvals and a feature flag.

security.secrets: No new secrets; existing environment variables are reused.
security.input_validation: Seat count is validated as a positive integer.
security.authz: Only workspace admins can change the seat count.

steps: Confirm invoices fall back to the legacy calculation
rollback.verification: billing.error_rate < 0.1% and invoice diff is zero for 10 minutes
